title: Company Income Growth
statementMd:
Petya works as a PR manager for a successful Berland company BerSoft. He needs to prepare a presentation on the company income growth since $2001$ (the year of its founding) till now. Petya knows that in $2001$ the company income amounted to $*a*_{1}$ billion bourles, in $2002$ — to $*a*_{2}$ billion, ..., and in the current $(2000 + *n*)$-th year — $*a*_{*n*}$ billion bourles. On the base of the information Petya decided to show in his presentation the linear progress history which is in his opinion perfect. According to a graph Petya has already made, in the first year BerSoft company income must amount to $1$ billion bourles, in the second year — $2$ billion bourles etc., each following year the income increases by $1$ billion bourles. Unfortunately, the real numbers are different from the perfect ones. Among the numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ can even occur negative ones that are a sign of the company’s losses in some years. That is why Petya wants to ignore some data, in other words, cross some numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ from the sequence and leave only some subsequence that has perfect growth.

Thus Petya has to choose a sequence of years $*y*_{1}$, $*y*_{2}$, ..., $*y*_{*k*}$,so that in the year $*y*_{1}$ the company income amounted to $1$ billion bourles, in the year $*y*_{2}$ — $2$ billion bourles etc., in accordance with the perfect growth dynamics. Help him to choose the longest such sequence.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$). The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($- 100 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$). The number $*a*_{*i*}$ determines the income of BerSoft company in the $(2000 + *i*)$-th year. The numbers in the line are separated by spaces.

## Output

Output $*k*$ — the maximum possible length of a perfect sequence. In the next line output the sequence of years $*y*_{1}$, $*y*_{2}$, ..., $*y*_{*k*}$. Separate the numbers by spaces. If the answer is not unique, output any. If no solution exist, output one number $0$.
statementZhMd:
Petya 是成功的 Berland 公司 BerSoft 的公关经理。他需要准备一份介绍公司自 $2001$ 年（公司成立年份）至今收入增长情况的演示文稿。Petya 知道，$2001$ 年公司的收入为 $*a*_{1}$ 十亿博勒，$2002$ 年为 $*a*_{2}$ 十亿博勒，……而在当前的第 $(2000 + *n*)$ 年为 $*a*_{*n*}$ 十亿博勒。根据这些信息，Petya 决定在演示文稿中展示他认为非常理想的线性增长历史。根据 Petya 已经制作的图表，BerSoft 公司第一年的收入应为 $1$ 十亿博勒，第二年应为 $2$ 十亿博勒，以此类推，即每年收入增加 $1$ 十亿博勒。

遗憾的是，实际数值与理想数值并不相同。在 $*a*_{*i*}$ 中甚至可能出现负数，这表示公司在某些年份出现了亏损。因此，Petya 想要忽略部分数据，换句话说，就是从序列中删去一些数 $*a*_{*i*}$，只保留一个具有理想增长的子序列。

因此，Petya 需要选择一个年份序列 $*y*_{1}$、$*y*_{2}$、……、$*y*_{*k*}$，使得公司在年份 $*y*_{1}$ 的收入为 $1$ 十亿博勒，在年份 $*y*_{2}$ 的收入为 $2$ 十亿博勒，以此类推，符合理想的增长规律。请帮助他选择这样一个最长的序列。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$- 100 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。数字 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示 BerSoft 公司在第 $(2000 + *i*)$ 年的收入。该行中的数字以空格分隔。

## 输出格式

输出 $*k*$，即理想序列可能达到的最大长度。下一行输出年份序列 $*y*_{1}$、$*y*_{2}$、……、$*y*_{*k*}$。数字之间以空格分隔。如果答案不唯一，输出任意一个即可。如果不存在解，则只输出一个数字 $0$。
